title: PLAIN/HADES owner-pattern conversation and follow-up subset, three repeats
classification: synthetic conversation diagnostic; no owner preference labels
source_revision_scope: HADES product code at the base revision; the benchmark runner and child-environment helper are fingerprinted separately by SHA-256 fields.

hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti Laptop GPU, 16384 MiB

methodology.pair_order: alternated by case/repeat with order offset 1; serialized requests
methodology.child_environment: allowlisted runtime basics only; inherited service credentials and proxy variables excluded
methodology.capture: timings, token counts, byte sizes and call counts only; no prompts or completions retained

ordinary_model_turn_subset_excluding_mis.reason: core-08 includes a pantry-expiry request with no canonical source, followed by a topic switch; exclude the entire conversation so differing fallback histories do not contaminate paired model turns.

missing_source_fast_path.observed_provider_metrics: three HADES turns had no provider request; the source code fast path and Grocy runtime test identify this as the canonical-source-unavailable expiry response.

limitations: Synthetic owner-pattern prompts; no response quality or naturalness grading.
No Open WebUI browser path, production deployment parity, or memory recall quality was measured.
Local latency varies by task; these samples do not establish an overall winner.
The all-case comparison includes a deliberate HADES no-model response for the missing-source expiry request; the clean conversational summary excludes that entire conversation.
The fixture has no household Grocy source or domain tools; it does not test actual expiry retrieval.
